tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.title: Comment on a task
tools.description: Adds a comment to a task, attributed to the signed in account. Use it to record a decision, an update or an answer where the work lives.

comment.description: Comment body. Plain text or simple HTML.

quoteCommentId.description: Comment id being replied to, if this is a reply.

taskId.description: The task the comment was added to.

tools.name: add_task_to_board
tools.title: Add a task to a board
tools.description: Puts an existing task onto a board. The task keeps its team, status and assignee; only its board membership changes.

taskId.description: Task id, from search_tasks or list_tasks.

taskBoardId.description: The board the task was added to.

annotations.title: Add a task to a board

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Creates a project in a workspace and attaches it to one or more teams. A project needs at least one team, because its tasks live in team backlogs.

teamIds.description: Team ids this project spans, from list_teams. At least one is required.

description.description: Project description. Plain text or simple HTML.

targetDate.description: ISO 8601 instant the project is due.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the project was created in.

tools.name: create_project_milestone
tools.title: Create a milestone
tools.description: Adds a milestone to a project. Tasks can then be filed against it with create_task or update_task.

description.description: Milestone description. Plain text or simple HTML.

targetDate.description: ISO 8601 instant the milestone is due.

projectId.description: The project the milestone was added to.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Creates a task in a team. Only workspaceId, teamId and title are required. Give it a due date to put it on the calendar, and an assignee account id to hand it to someone. Returns the created task, including its reference such as ENG-42.

title.description: One line summary of the work.

description.description: Task body. Plain text or simple HTML.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, from list_workspace_members.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 instant the work should start.

dueDate.description: ISO 8601 instant the work is due.

projectId.description: Project to file this task under.

topicId.description: Label to apply, from list_topics on the team.

boardId.description: Board to add the task to on creation.

reference.description: Human readable reference, for example ENG-42.

workflowStateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, or null.

ownerId.description: Account id of whoever created the task.

projectId.description: Project this task belongs to, or null.

milestoneId.description: Milestone this task belongs to, or null.

topicId.description: Label applied to this task, or null.

tools.name: create_task_board
tools.title: Create a board
tools.description: Creates an empty board in a team. Add tasks to it afterwards with add_task_to_board.

dueDate.description: ISO 8601 instant the board's work is due.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a Jinear record
tools.description: Reads the full text of one record previously returned by search, given its id. Returns the title, the body as text, and a link a person can open.

url.description: Absolute Jinear URL a person can open.

tools.name: get_file_link
tools.title: Get a link to a file
tools.description: Returns the Jinear download link for a stored file, suitable for citing back to the person or for them to click. Opening the link uses the reader's own Jinear permissions, so it works for anyone who can already see the file, and for files shared with anyone who has the link. It does not return the file's contents.

materialId.description: File id, from list_files. Must be a FILE, not a FOLDER.
The file this link points at.

url.description: Absolute Jinear URL that downloads the file.

annotations.title: Get a link to a file

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get one note
tools.description: Reads a single note in full, including its body. Use it after search_notes when the contents of a specific note are needed.

parentNoteId.description: Parent note when the note is nested, otherwise null.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get one project
tools.description: Reads a single project by id, including its state, priority, dates and lead.

archived.description: True when the project is archived.

leadWorkspaceMemberId.description: Membership id of the project lead, or null.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get one task
tools.description: Reads a single task in full, including its body, by its human readable reference such as ENG-42. Use it after search_tasks or list_tasks when the body of a specific task is needed.

workspaceUsername.description: Workspace handle, the username field from list_workspaces.

teamTag.description: Team tag, the part before the dash in a reference such as ENG-42.

taskNumber.description: Task number, the part after the dash in a reference such as ENG-42.

reference.description: Human readable reference, for example ENG-42.

workflowStateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, or null.

ownerId.description: Account id of whoever created the task.

projectId.description: Project this task belongs to, or null.

milestoneId.description: Milestone this task belongs to, or null.

topicId.description: Label applied to this task, or null.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.title: Get a workspace
tools.description: Reads one workspace by its id or by its short username handle. Use it to resolve a workspace a person named in conversation into a workspaceId.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Supply this or username.

username.description: Short workspace handle, as it appears in a Jinear URL. Supply this or workspaceId.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Pass this to any tool that takes workspaceId.

username.description: Short workspace handle used in Jinear URLs.

role.description: The caller's role in this workspace.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events in a date range
tools.description: Lists everything on a workspace's calendar between two instants: tasks that carry dates and events synced from an attached Google Calendar. Use it to answer what is happening this week or when someone is busy.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO 8601 instant.

to.description: End of the window, as an ISO 8601 instant.

teamIds.description: Restrict to the calendars of these teams.

items.description: Events and dated tasks in the window.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 end, or null for an all day event.

sourceType.description: JINEAR for a native event, GOOGLE_CALENDAR for a synced one, TASK for a task shown on the calendar.

relatedTaskId.description: Task this event mirrors, or null.

annotations.title: List calendar events in a date range

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List files and folders
tools.description: Lists the contents of a workspace's file storage, one folder at a time. Omit parentFolderId to list the root. Returns both folders and files; pass a folder's materialId back as parentFolderId to descend into it.

parentFolderId.description: Folder to list. Omit for the root of the workspace.

type.description: Return only FOLDER entries or only FILE entries. Omit for both.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

items.description: Files and folders in this location.

parentMaterialId.description: Containing folder, or null at the root.

mediaId.description: Stored media id for a file, null for a folder.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.title: List notebooks
tools.description: Lists the notebooks in a workspace. A notebook groups related notes, and its id is what narrows search_notes to one place.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.
Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_project_milestones
tools.title: List a project's milestones
tools.description: Lists the milestones of one project, in project order. Milestone ids from here are what create_task and update_task take as milestoneId.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Lists the projects in a workspace. By default only active projects are returned; set scope to ARCHIVED for archived ones, or ASSIGNED for the projects the signed in account leads or belongs to.

scope.description: Which projects to return. Defaults to ALL.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

archived.description: True when the project is archived.

leadWorkspaceMemberId.description: Membership id of the project lead, or null.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_task_boards
tools.title: List a team's boards
tools.description: Lists the boards belonging to a team, newest first. A board groups tasks for a sprint, a release or any other batch of work.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.
Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_task_comments
tools.title: List a task's comments
tools.description: Reads the discussion on a task, newest first. Use it to catch up on what has already been said before answering or adding a comment.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the comment was posted.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks with filters
tools.description: Lists tasks in a workspace, optionally narrowed by team, assignee, workflow status, state group, project, milestone or a date range. This is the tool for questions like what is in progress, what is assigned to someone, or what is due this week.

assigneeIds.description: Restrict to tasks assigned to these account ids, from list_workspace_members.

workflowStatusIds.description: Restrict to these status ids, from list_workflow_statuses.

stateGroups.description: Restrict by state group. Any of BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.

projectIds.description: Restrict to tasks in these projects.

milestoneIds.description: Restrict to tasks on these milestones.

from.description: Only tasks whose dates fall on or after this ISO 8601 instant.

to.description: Only tasks whose dates fall on or before this ISO 8601 instant.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: Items per page, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

reference.description: Human readable reference, for example ENG-42.

workflowStateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, or null.

ownerId.description: Account id of whoever created the task.

projectId.description: Project this task belongs to, or null.

milestoneId.description: Milestone this task belongs to, or null.

topicId.description: Label applied to this task, or null.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.title: List teams in a workspace
tools.description: Lists the teams inside a workspace. Tasks and boards belong to a team, so a teamId from here is needed before creating a task or reading a team's board.

teamId.description: Team id. Required by every task tool.

username.description: Short team handle used in Jinear URLs.

tag.description: Short prefix used in task references, as in ENG-42.

taskVisibility.description: Who can see this team's tasks.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: List a team's topics
tools.description: Lists the topics a team uses to label its tasks. Read this to turn a label a person named into the topicId create_task takes.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

topicId.description: Topic id, the value create_task takes as topicId.

tag.description: Short prefix used in task references.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_workflow_statuses
tools.title: List a team's workflow statuses
tools.description: Lists the workflow statuses a team's tasks can be in, such as Backlog, In Progress or Done. Statuses are defined per team and referenced by id, so read this before calling set_task_status.

items.description: Statuses this team's tasks can be in, in board order.

workflowStatusId.description: Status id. This is what set_task_status takes.

name.description: Display name, for example In Progress.

stateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

order.description: Position in the team's board, left to right.

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.title: List workspace members
tools.description: Lists the people in a workspace with their account ids. Use it to turn a person's name into the accountId that create_task and update_task take as an assignee.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: Items per page, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

accountId.description: Account id. This is the value assignee fields take.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists every Jinear workspace the signed in account belongs to, with the account's role in each. Call this first: workspaceId is required by almost every other Jinear tool.

items.description: The workspaces this account belongs to.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id. Pass this to any tool that takes workspaceId.

username.description: Short workspace handle used in Jinear URLs.

role.description: The caller's role in this workspace.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Jinear
tools.description: Searches tasks and note titles across every Jinear workspace the signed in account belongs to, and returns ids and links suitable for citation. Pass an id from here to fetch to read the full record. For filtering by status, assignee or dates, use list_tasks instead.

query.description: What to look for, in plain language.

id.description: Opaque id to pass to fetch.

url.description: Absolute Jinear URL a person can open.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes by title
tools.description: Lists notes in a workspace, optionally inside one notebook or under one parent note, and optionally narrowed to titles containing a phrase. Returns titles and ids; call get_note for a note's body.

notebookId.description: Restrict to one notebook, from list_notebooks.

parentNoteId.description: Restrict to the children of one note.

titleContains.description: Case insensitive phrase to match against note titles.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

parentNoteId.description: Parent note when the note is nested, otherwise null.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks by text
tools.description: Finds tasks in a workspace whose title or body matches a plain language query. Use this when the person names a task by what it is about rather than by its reference. Use list_tasks instead when filtering by status, assignee or dates.

query.description: Free text to match against task titles and bodies.

teamIds.description: Restrict the search to these teams. Omit to search the whole workspace.

page.description: Zero based page number. Defaults to 0.

reference.description: Human readable reference, for example ENG-42.

workflowStateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, or null.

ownerId.description: Account id of whoever created the task.

projectId.description: Project this task belongs to, or null.

milestoneId.description: Milestone this task belongs to, or null.

topicId.description: Label applied to this task, or null.

page.description: Zero based page number of this result.

totalElements.description: Total matching items across all pages.

hasNext.description: True when another page is available.

tools.name: set_task_status
tools.title: Move a task to a workflow status
tools.description: Moves a task into one of its team's workflow statuses, for example from In Progress to Done. Statuses are per team and referenced by id, so call list_workflow_statuses for the task's team first. Jinear does not delete tasks; retiring one means moving it to a status in the CANCELLED group.

workflowStatusId.description: Status id, from list_workflow_statuses for the task's team.

reference.description: Human readable reference, for example ENG-42.

workflowStateGroup.description: BACKLOG, NOT_STARTED, STARTED, COMPLETED or CANCELLED.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the assignee, or null.

ownerId.description: Account id of whoever created the task.

projectId.description: Project this task belongs to, or null.

milestoneId.description: Milestone this task belongs to, or null.

topicId.description: Label applied to this task, or null.

task.description: The task in its new status.

annotations.title: Move a task to a workflow status

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update a project
tools.description: Changes a project's title, description, state, priority, dates or archived flag. Supply only the fields to change; anything omitted is left alone.

description.description: New description. Plain text or simple HTML.

archived.description: True to archive the project, false to restore it.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Changes a task's title, body, dates, assignee, project or milestone. Supply only the fields to change; anything omitted is left alone. Use set_task_status to move a task between workflow statuses.

taskId.description: Task id, from search_tasks, list_tasks or get_task.

description.description: New task body. Plain text or simple HTML.

assignedTo.description: Account id of the new assignee. Pass an empty string to unassign.

startDate.description: New ISO 8601 start. Pass an empty string to clear it.

dueDate.description: New ISO 8601 due date. Pass an empty string to clear it.

projectId.description: Move the task into this project.

milestoneId.description: Move the task onto this milestone.
